title: polypodium iridifolium
intro: Polypodium iridifolium, commonly known as the Leptosporangiate fern, is a species of fern in the genus Polypodium. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Polypodium iridifolium include pain relief, wound healing, and the treatment of respiratory issues, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. Studies have also identified the presence of sesquiterpenoids and alkaloids in this plant, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
